audience.role: Plugin users, 0.6.1 upgraders, and maintainers deciding the known-risk boundary

checks.note: Each README covers first use and upgrade; SECURITY.md supplies security and risk guidance and is represented as release_notes because the schema lacks a policy role.
Each language supplies prerequisites, conditional installation, locale command, expected HTML/JSON, wait, model privacy choice and upgrade limits; the policy explains the risk scope.
The first path names session input and local report output, introduces host and Bundle context, and places technical mechanics later.
All README risk summaries agree with the security policy on the limited 0.7.0 decision and unresolved vulnerability; readiness is separate and linked to an acceptance record.
Prerequisite and risk cautions precede installation; provider handling, costs and disclosure limits precede the first semantic command. Detailed operation follows.
English, Chinese and Russian were fully read independently; each gives its locale command, output, waiting, default provider boundary, upgrade and risk summary.
